Initial release of AI大模型专家｜电商品牌 GEO 内容优化

- Helps e-commerce and content teams break down GEO, product AI search, and brand listing goals into actionable planning, structured content, evidence fields, and generation tasks.
- Provides end-to-end workflows from personas, storyboards, and scenes to short drama/animation scripts and video/image generation.
- Supports structured Q&A, direct answers with evidence, and recurring visibility audits across major AI search models.
- Integrates with AI-HIVE for unified media upload, content generation, pricing snapshots, and cross-model routing.
- Designed for real commercial delivery: scalable naming, versioning, cost control, and compliance with copyright and safety standards.
